artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan (3.25h) adding a .claude-extensions.json source_dir resolution route to system-defect-record.sh's Signal B --dispatched-agent branch, with a new fixture suite and full-gate attestation.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system corpus, adding a new shell test suite requires exactly two declaration surfaces and no runner edit: (1) agent-system/extensions/<ext>/manifest.json's provides.scripts, regenerated mechanically by sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write and blocked on by verify-deploy gate 3's check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q; (2) scripts/tests/suite-classification.data, where lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh treats an unclassified discovered suite as a violation in its own right. tests/run-all.sh needs NO edit because it discovers suites by globbing scripts/tests/test-*.sh, and tests/suite-cost-hints.txt plus tests/known-failures.txt are documented advisory-only (a missing row never changes which suites run). This matters for territory planning: the three no-edit files are frequently inside a concurrent task's declared file_scope, so the glob-discovery property removes a collision at zero cost. Companion test-design idiom: to assert a script's internally-computed path string without copying its event-write dependency chain into a fixture, feed the fixture an orchestrator-critical-paths.json marking the expected path recursion_guard:true -- the recursion guard then exits 0 and echoes the resolved path verbatim in stderr.
